Class Music

java.lang.Object
audio.Music
public abstract class Music extends Object
The background music: one Track at a time, played in a loop until another one is asked for.

This class decides what plays; subclasses only say which tracks they have and start or silence one (Template Method). Asking again for the track that plays changes nothing, so the game can ask on every frame and the music goes on through a death or a pause. A track whose file is missing is replaced by the hub's. The volume can be changed while a track plays. When no sound can be played, none() stands in for the music, so the rest of the game never has to check.
